title: QUALICOPC - Shared Decision Making in referrals by general practitioners
descriptions: This set contains a selection of variables from the QUALICOPC (Quality and Costs of Primary Care in Europe) database on primary care in 32 countries. The data concern variables related to the GPs' level of shared decision making in referrals and potential determinants, such as GP characteristics and level of gatekeeping.

The response numbers for this particular dataset are described in the file 'QUALICOPC - Recruitment procedures and response rates.pdf'.The depositor provided the file 'QUALICOPC GP 5.1 - SDM in referrals' in XLSX format. DANS added the CSV format of this file.
